title: Seraph Horizons recipe export
description: One export of the pack's items and recipes, dumped from a running dedicated server. See docs/recipe-browser/schema.md.

mods.description: Every loaded mod, the base game's own (game, survival, creative) included. Keyed by mod id, which is also the asset domain used in codes unless `domains` says otherwise.

items.description: Items and blocks, keyed by full code (domain:path). Holds every handbook-visible collectible plus every collectible a recipe or source references.

recipes.description: One record per recipe definition. Sorted by id.

recipeTypes.description: One entry per recipe type present in `recipes`, keyed by the type code.

guides.description: Handbook guide pages that are not tied to one item.

variantGroups.description: The pack's own mod's Tidy Variants groups: variants the game shows as one creative tile and one handbook group. Keyed by the group's id (`auto:<domain>:<base>[/<dim>=<value>...]`, an override rule's id, or `groupby:<block|item>:<domain>:<pattern>`). Absent without the pack's mod, or with Tidy Variants off or unresolved.

power.description: Mechanical power producers, consumers and the wind (docs/recipe-browser/power.md). Optional: absent in exports made before it existed.

multiblocks.description: Structures a player builds block by block, which a block checks against a layout (the game's `multiblockStructure` attribute), with the shape of a block that fits each cell. Absent from older exports. See docs/recipe-browser/multiblocks.md.

shapes.description: How each block a part is drawn with (`multiblockPart.block`) looks, by code.

code.description: A full asset code: domain, colon, path. Always lower case, domain always present.

codePattern.description: A code that may contain `*` wildcards and `{name}` placeholders. The domain can be a wildcard too: `*:plank-*` accepts planks of every mod.

extra.description: Data that does not fit the schema yet. Readers must ignore what they do not know.

domains.description: Asset domains this mod owns, when they differ from its id.

litres.description: Set for liquids measured in litres.

name.description: Display name of this exact stack, when attributes change it.

mod.description: Id of the mod that registered it; a key of `mods`.

description.description: English handbook or tooltip text. May contain VTML markup.

value.description: Base value in rusty gears per item, or per litre with `valuePerLitre`: the pack's item value table (`values[code]`, seraphhorizons:config/item-values.json). Absent when the table has no value of its own for the code, or without the pack's mod.

floorZero.description: Present, true, when the table lists the code as worth under a gear per full stack.

valuePerLitre.description: Present, true, when `value` is per litre, not per item: a liquid the table prices by the litre (its `perLitre`). Only with a `value`.

valueSwitches.description: The table's `switches[code]`: config switches the value exists only with (its cheapest route takes a recipe or item they add).

switch.description: The config switch that adds the item itself: with it off the item does not exist.

id.description: Unique: the checking block's domain and first code part, with -2, -3... on a clash.

code.description: The block that checks the layout, the one drawn at [0, 0, 0] (a north-facing variant when there is one).

codes.description: Every block that carries this same layout (its variants).

parts.description: What a cell takes; a cell names one by index.

sizes.description: The layout; several for a structure that comes in sizes (`multiblockSizes`), smallest first as the block lists them.

cells.description: [x, y, z, part]: blocks from the checking block (x east, y up, z south), in the layout's own frame, unturned.

defaultSize.description: Index of the size shown first; 0 when absent.

pattern.description: The layout's block code pattern: a game wildcard, or a regular expression after `@`.

air.description: The cell may (or, without `block`, must) be empty.

block.description: The block the cell is drawn with, a key of `multiblocks.shapes`. Absent when only air fits.

name.description: Its English name; absent when it has none of its own.

accepts.description: Blocks that fit, in registry order, at most 24.

acceptsMore.description: How many more fit than `accepts` lists.

draw.description: `cube`: a full block; `none`: nothing to draw (an invisible part of a bigger block); `shape`: `shapes`.

shapes.description: The block's shape and its overlays, as the block turns them.

shapeElement.description: A shape file's element, in voxels (16 a block), children relative to their parent's `from`: only what places its box.

faces.description: The faces drawn, when not all six.

title.description: The group's English title as the game shows it: its lang title, else one derived from the members' names, else the representative's name.

members.description: Codes of `items`, best representative first. A code is in at most one group.

configSwitch.description: A switch of the pack's own mod: a bool of ModConfig/seraphhorizons.json, by its name there.

fertilizer.description: Nutrients the item adds to farmland, in percent, as the handbook shows them (attributes.fertilizerProps).

storageFlags.description: Names of the EnumItemStorageFlags set on the item, lower case.

groundStorage.description: How the item is put down on the ground (Shift + right click; the game's GroundStorable behavior). Absent when it cannot be. Numbers are the ones the game's ground storage block uses.

layout.description: The game's layout, lower case: placed one at the centre (singlecenter), two side by side (halves), two against a wall (wallhalves), four in quadrants (quadrants); a loose pile of up to 12 (messy12); or a pile (stacking).

capacity.description: Items one block holds: 1, 2, 2, 4 and 12 for the layouts above, the item's stacking capacity for a pile.

transfer.description: Items put down or taken per click. Only for messy12 and stacking.

bulkTransfer.description: Items per click with Ctrl held. Only for messy12 (at most 12) and stacking.

requiresCtrl.description: Ctrl must be held as well to put it down. Present only when true.

solidTop.description: A full pile is solid on top, so blocks and more piles can go on it. Only for stacking; present only when true.

maxPilesHigh.description: Most piles of the item one column may hold. Only with solidTop, and only when the item sets a limit.

fullHeight.description: Height of a full pile's collision box, in blocks. Only for stacking, when the game gives the pile a box.

source.description: One way to obtain the item other than a recipe.

from.description: Code of the block, entity or trader.

tool.description: Tool type required for this drop.

ingredient.description: One ingredient slot as the recipe defines it, before wildcard resolution.

key.description: Grid recipes: the pattern character of this ingredient.

wildcardName.description: Variable the wildcard binds, used as `{name}` in outputs.

role.description: Type-specific role, e.g. alloy or cooking slot code.

minQuantity.description: Cooking: fewest stacks of this ingredient.

maxQuantity.description: Cooking: most stacks of this ingredient.

output.description: An output as the recipe defines it; the code may contain `{name}` placeholders.

variant.description: One resolved form of the recipe. A recipe without wildcards has exactly one.

bindings.description: Wildcard variable values of this variant, e.g. {"wood": "oak"}.

ingredients.description: Aligned with the recipe's `ingredients`: for each slot, the concrete stacks accepted. An empty list means nothing registered matches.

hours.description: In-game hours: the average and the spread each stack draws its own value from.

voxelLayers.description: Layers bottom to top; each layer is rows of equal length; `#` is filled, `_` is empty.

id.description: Unique and stable between exports of the same pack: `<type>|<source asset>|<index in that asset>`.

mod.description: Id of the mod whose asset defines the recipe; a key of `mods`.

source.description: Asset location of the defining file.

enabled.description: False when the definition is switched off. Absent means true.

switch.description: The config switch of the pack's own mod that adds the recipe: with it off the recipe does not exist.

pattern.description: `height` rows of `width` characters. Each character is an ingredient `key`; `_` is an empty cell.

sealHours.description: 0 means no sealing: mixing is instant.

alloy.description: type alloy only. Ratios live on the ingredients.

cooking.description: type cooking only. Slot quantities live on the ingredients.

construction.description: type construction only: a block placed, then built up stage by stage with right clicks. Each ingredient is consumed by exactly one stage.

stages.description: In build order. The first is the block as placed and never asks for anything.

ingredients.description: Indices into the recipe's `ingredients` consumed by this stage.

action.description: English name of the right-click action when it is not "Construct", e.g. Launch.

butchery.description: type butchery only: what one creature gives, stage by stage, with the Butchering mod. Each ingredient belongs to exactly one stage, through its `ingredients`, `options` or `optional`.

entityType.description: The entity type file the creatures are variants of, e.g. game:deer.

workload.description: The carcass's butcheringWorkLoad (small, medium, large): how long the stations take and how long it bleeds.

condition.description: The lowest and highest condition (the game's animalWeight) a creature can be in. Outputs with `condition` in `extra.scaledBy` are multiplied by it. Missing in exports from before it was added.

stages.description: In the order a player goes through them. A `harvest` stage is the alternative to all the others: the body cut up where it lies.

step.description: pickUp: right-click the dead creature with an empty hand. skin: on a hook, with a knife. bleed: left on the hook. butcher: on a table. harvest: with a knife where it lies.

ingredients.description: Indices into the recipe's `ingredients` the stage needs: the carcass it takes, the station, the tool.

options.description: Groups of ingredient indices; the stage needs one group as well as `ingredients` (a knife or a cleaver).

optional.description: Ingredient indices the stage does without; an output that needs one names it in `extra.needs`.

outputs.description: Indices into the recipe's `outputs` the stage gives.

multiplier.description: harvest: the share of the creature's drops the mod leaves, already applied to the yields.

variants.description: Aligned with the recipe's `variants`: which creatures each is, and how much of each output it gives.

yields.description: Aligned with the recipe's `outputs`: the quantity (average and spread) before station efficiency and the creature's condition, or null when this variant does not give it.

transition.description: shape transition only: the first ingredient turns into the one output after some in-game hours, by itself (the collectible's transitionableProps) or on a station a further ingredient names (role station, not consumed), such as a smoking rack. The output's quantity is stacks out per stack in.

type.description: The kind: the engine's EnumTransitionType in lower case (perish, dry, cure, ripen, melt, harden, burn, convert), or a mod's own process (smoke: the Butchering mod's smoking rack).

transitionHours.description: Hours it then takes; the stack turns at freshHours plus transitionHours.

tub.description: shape tub only: a batch of gears (the ingredient with role batch) sits in a liquid (role liquid; its litres are what a finished batch uses up) in a vessel (role station) until it turns into the first output. With `failure`, gears can be lost to that output: one every `lossEveryHours` once the batch has been left `graceHours` past done, and each with `lossChance` at done.

kind.description: pickle: the metal comes out clean (an acid). passivate: the surface comes out passive (nitric acid). rust: it rusts through (brine, older exports).

hours.description: In-game hours from the batch going in with the liquid to done.

litresPerBatch.description: Litres of the liquid a finished batch uses up.

graceHours.description: Hours past done before the liquid starts on the batch.

lossEveryHours.description: Once the grace is over, one gear is lost every this many hours.

lossChance.description: Each gear's chance, 0 to 1, to come out as the failure output at done.

failure.description: Index into `outputs` of what a lost gear becomes.

lottery.description: shape lottery only: the one ingredient is decided by chance, item by item, into one of the outcomes. The chances add up to 1 and each output belongs to exactly one outcome.

trigger.description: When it is decided. inventory: when it lands in a player's inventory.

outputs.description: Indices into `outputs`: what the item becomes in this outcome (none: it is lost).

machine.description: shape machine only: a powered machine (an ingredient with role station) turns the consumed ingredients into the outputs, one job at a time. Ingredients in `kept` are fitted to it and never consumed; a tool ingredient (isTool) loses its toolDurabilityCost per job.

power.description: mechanical: the game's mechanical power network, `turns` the input shaft's. hand: worked by a player holding right-click on it, `turns` those of its hand clock (the press brake's lever, the squaring shear's treadle, a turn a second).

turns.description: Turns of the machine's input shaft one job takes.

work.description: What a job is made of: `amount` of `unit` (12 teeth), `turnsPerUnit` each.

kept.description: Indices into `ingredients` fitted to the machine and never consumed.

wear.description: How the tool ingredient `ingredient` wears. fixed: its toolDurabilityCost per job. dividedByOilFill: that divided by the oil tank's fill (0 to 1), so a half-full tank wears it twice as fast and an empty one breaks it.

oil.description: The machine's oil tank: the oil ingredient `ingredient` fills it, and each job drains `points` of its `tank` (100 points to the litre).

requirements.description: Anything else needed, in plain English, e.g. a trait or a machine.

count.description: Number of records of this type in `recipes`.

shape.description: Which type-specific block the records carry. `generic` has none.

registry.description: Engine registry or mod system the recipes were read from.

text.description: English text. May contain VTML markup.

power.description: Mechanical power: producers, consumers and the wind (docs/recipe-browser/power.md). Parameters only; the app derives torque, power and equilibria. Absent in exports made before it existed.

powerSource.description: Where a power figure was read from.

from.description: Where it came from: a config file, `block attributes ...`, `code constant (<class>)` or `code default (<class>)`.

fallback.description: True when the exporter could not read the live value and used its built-in default.

powerModel.description: A producer's torque model. `rotor`: torque(s) = max(0, targetSpeed − s) × torqueFactor. `wind`: a rotor whose target speed is min(speedCap, wind × speedPerWind). `constantPower`: torque(s) = budget / max(s, minSpeed) up to taperFrom, then falling linearly to 0 at shaftSpeed.

turbulencePenalty.description: The game halves a vanilla windmill's torque factor when another windmill is within 1.5 × sails blocks.

id.description: Unique within the export, stable across versions: `game:windmillrotor-metal@10`.

item.description: The item the page links to (a key of `items`), or null.

shownKN.description: What the game's block info reads as "Sails power output" (kN), or null where it shows none.

item.description: The item the page links to (a key of `items`), or null.

category.description: `machine` works, `transmission` only passes power (friction), `brake` stops it.

load.description: Load while working, fully oiled; the low end of a ranged load.

loadMax.description: The high end of a ranged load.

idleLoad.description: Load while idle, unfinished or empty, where the game sets one.

oil.description: A machine with a seraphhorizons MachineOil tank: dry load = load × dryMultiplier; `tank` in litres.

note.description: How the load is made up.

simulation.description: Game years run, samples per game hour and RNG seed. Deterministic.

altitude.description: Wind at height = sea-level wind × max(1, base + blocks above sea level / divisor), capped at `cap`.

histogram.description: Sea-level wind, share of time per bin of `binWidth` from 0; negative strengths count in the first bin. Shares sum to 1.

mean.description: Mean sea-level wind over the simulation, negative strengths counted as 0.

sources.description: The asset each pattern was read from, and the model's code constants.

durationMeanHours.description: Mean duration in hours, from the distribution: invexp's is durationAvgHours + durationVarHours / 4.

durationDist.description: The duration's NatFloat distribution, lower case: `invexp`, `uniform`, ...

share.description: Share of game time the pattern is active in the simulation.

gusts.description: True when the pattern adds the game's gust noise to its base strength.
